title: Claude-Mem 作例・解説動画
message: 前回の判断を、必要な分だけ取り出す。
audience: エージェントに前回の判断を思い出させたい、日本語で読みたい開発者・制作担当
next_action: 作例ページ（../index.html#C05）で8場面の入力と実際の戻り値を読む

output.orientation: landscape only; no portrait or square composition is authored

authorship.film_code_and_japanese_copy: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) wrote index.html, video.css, video.js, storyboard.json and README.md in this folder.
authorship.inputs: input/notes.json (five fictional notes) and input/scenarios.json were authored by the Studio Yebisu production side and frozen before execution; not by Opus.
authorship.execution: The production side ran the unmodified Claude-Mem worker functions with Bun and recorded outputs/memory-run.json; no language model generated the captured API responses.
authorship.screenshots: video/assets/phone.png and desktop.png are byte-for-byte copies of native IAB Chromium captures of the Studio Yebisu viewer page, taken by the production side.

files.role: actual run record; every visible title, ID, body and count
independent read-only SQLite audit; cross-checked, not drawn
frozen fictional notes; compared with saved and returned text

sources.fetch_rule: video.js fetches the manifest as assets/data-hashes.json and each key as new URL('../' + key, document.baseURI), same origin only. Any missing file or SHA-256 mismatch rejects window.motionReady; there is no embedded fallback.

scope.shown: Explicit saveMemory notes, SQLite FTS5 keyword search, the real mem_search progressive steps (guided and auto) in one Bun process and one fresh Bun process.
not_shown_or_claimed: automatic observation, LLM compression or context injection
MCP transport (the mem-search SKILL steps were applied directly to the worker function)
authentication or access control (project is a search scope only)
scope.excluded_from_screen: No fake terminal or log, no opaque ms_ cursor string, no full hashes, no automatic-check score as marketing.

design.fonts: Local system fonts only: "Noto Sans JP", "Yu Gothic", YuGothic, Meiryo, sans-serif; Consolas/Cascadia Mono for IDs. No downloads.

type_scale_px_at_1280.headline: 60 (closing message 56)
type_scale_px_at_1280.primary_numbers: 150 (120 in scene 6, 96 for the zero body count)

design.continuity: The note chosen in C04/C05 (N01) is one paper card for 0–22 s: small card → index row → context row → expanded body card → scope card → into the SQLite drum. A yellow circle on it carries the step number 1 → 2 → 3.
persistent: masthead: Claude-Mem version and the sample IDs on screen
footer: 手で保存 / SQLite FTS5 / 28秒・無音 and source repository, version, short commit, license

scenes.headline: 前回の判断、どこだっけ。
scenes.conveys: The original job: five notes were saved by hand in two fictional projects.
scenes.enter: Headline rises 0.15–0.55 s; five small cards drop in save order 0.5–1.78 s; the large count rises 0 → 5 as they land.
scenes.exit: Number block fades 3.65–4.0 s; non-indexed cards leave at 4.0 s.

scenes.headline: まず、題名だけ。
scenes.conveys: The guided index returns titles and IDs only, in the returned order N02 then N01; zero bodies.
scenes.enter: Cards move into two index rows 4.0–4.45 s; step rail ① lights; large 2 題名 and 0 本文.
scenes.hold: 4.45–7.65 s; the caller's choice of N01 is marked 5.6–6.0 s (yellow circle 1, pencil underline, label 呼び出し側が選ぶ).
scenes.exit: Choice label fades 7.65–8.0 s; rows reorder at 8.0 s.
scenes.note: The film does not claim the choice was made automatically or by AI.

scenes.headline: 前後を見て、選ぶ。
scenes.conveys: Context for the chosen N01: N01 and its one neighbour N02, still titles only.
scenes.enter: Rows reorder to the returned context order 8.0–8.45 s; rail ② lights; circle on N01 shows 2; pencil under 0 本文 8.5–8.9 s; bracket 前後1件まで 8.4–8.8 s.

scenes.headline: 選んだ1件の本文へ。
scenes.conveys: Exactly one full body is fetched: the chosen N01, shown with its actual content.
scenes.enter: N01 card expands 12.0–12.5 s while N02 leaves; body fades in 12.35–12.85 s; phone screenshot slides in 12.5–12.95 s; excerpt block 12.8–13.2 s; pencil underline of the excerpt inside the body 12.9–13.3 s.
scenes.hold: 13.3–17.65 s (poster frame 13.5 s is fully settled)
scenes.exit: Body fades and card shrinks from 18.0 s; phone and excerpt fade 17.65–18.0 s.

data.body: observations[0].content split at the first blank line: subtitle 'Manual memory' + body equal to input N01 text
data.excerpt: second sentence of that body, drawn at 40 px and labelled 本文から抜粋
data.steps: observations trace operations search → timeline → fetch, shown as 索引 → 文脈 → 本文

scenes.note: The excerpt is a substring of the returned body, not a generated answer.

scenes.headline: 同じ問いを、別の案件へ。
scenes.conveys: The same query iOS in auto mode returns N01 for sakura-site and N04 for tsubaki-docs.
scenes.enter: N01 shrinks to a scope card 18.05–18.5 s; N04 enters from the right 18.1–18.55 s; arrows from the shared query 18.3–18.7 s; pencil under the differing part of each title 18.7–19.1 s.
scenes.exit: Scope elements and rail fade 21.65–22.0 s; N04 leaves right at 22.0 s.

data.scope_note: samples[C06].output.scope_note (rendered as: project は検索の範囲を分けるだけで、認証ではありません。)

scenes.headline: 次のプロセスでも、同じメモから。
scenes.headline_note: Refined from the brief's 「次のプロセスでも、続きから。」 because the old continuation cursor is rejected in the new process; the notes, not the cursor, carry over.
scenes.conveys: A fresh Bun process reopens the same SQLite file: playsinline returns N02 with the same ID 2; five notes (3 + 2) remain; the previous process's continuation is invalid here.
scenes.enter: N01 card sinks into the SQLite drum 22.0–22.45 s; N02 card rises out to the right 22.45–22.95 s; count 5 件のまま 22.3–22.7 s; ID pencil 22.95–23.3 s; old-cursor row 22.9–23.3 s with strike 23.1–23.45 s.

contract.canvas: getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }); backing store equals renderConfig width × height
contract.seek: window.seek(seconds) clamps to 0..28 and returns a Promise that resolves after the requested frame is drawn from absolute time; no frame depends on earlier frames, wall clock or randomness
contract.ready: window.motionReady resolves after the manifest and eight files match SHA-256, records validate, both images decode at their recorded size and local fonts are loaded
contract.export_mode: window.__MOTION_RENDER__ === true: controls hidden, canvas only at exact size, no requestAnimationFrame preview
contract.preview: Starts paused at 0. #play / #pause / #reset, #scrub (range 0–28 step 0.1), #time (number 0–28 step 0.1), #time-label; #editor[data-state] is paused or playing; #play is disabled while playing and #pause while paused
